i.norm: Verifies that overriding a Value where every accessor is NONE with a Value that only sets the scalar-constructor visibility (leaving all other accessors at DEFAULT) returns the original instance unchanged. Because DEFAULT in the override means "keep the base value", and the base is already NONE for every accessor, withOverrides() produces a Value equal to the base and therefore returns the base itself.
Base Value: every accessor explicitly set to NONE.
Override Value: only the scalar-constructor accessor is set (to NONE); every other accessor stays at DEFAULT.
The override-only Value keeps DEFAULT for all non-scalar accessors...
...and NONE only for the scalar constructor it explicitly configured.
Merging produced no actual change, so the base instance is returned as-is.
